chunks: We had tried the people of Pharaoh before them. A respected prophet had come to them (saying):
ai.seo_question: Who did God send as a messenger to the people of Pharaoh?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ad-Dukhan, this verse underscores the pattern of divine testing (fitnah) by recalling the Pharaoh's people, to whom a noble messenger was sent. Shia exegesis often highlights this as a precursor to the trials faced by the Ahl al-Bayt, illustrating that rejection of the 'noble messenger' leads to severe divine retribution. The verse serves as a warning that despite clear guidance, arrogance and denial persist among the disbelievers.
